title: Exciter (AVR)
description: Excitation system of a synchronous machine: SEXS, IEEE Type 1, the alternator-rectifier EXAC1 / ESAC1A, the static ESST4B, the potential-source static EXST1 / ESST1A, the static SCRX, the dc commutator ESDC1A, EXDC2 or IEEEX1, the PID alternator ESAC8B, or the compound-source static ESST3A. The CLI RMS study's typical, clearly indicative settings are the code defaults. Dynamics wiring: Mark-gated. markGated (N312, October 2026): false on every parameter a gridsim-dynamics/2 file feeds into the RMS study (F23, wired).

model.description: Exciter / AVR model. EXAC1 (IEEE 1981 AC1) and ESAC1A (IEEE 421.5-2005 AC1A) are the alternator-rectifier exciters: they read the machine's field current (rectifier regulation FEX and the demagnetising term KD) and take the ac... parameters, all required. ESST4B (IEEE 421.5-2005 ST4B) is the static exciter with outer voltage and inner field PI regulators fed from a potential and/or compound source: it reads the terminal voltage and current and the field current, and takes the st4b... parameters, all required. EXST1 (IEEE 1981 ST1) and ESST1A (IEEE 421.5-2005 ST1A) are the potential-source controlled-rectifier exciters whose ceiling is Vt VRMAX - KC IFD: they read the terminal voltage and the field current and take the st1... parameters (ESST1A also the st1a... ones). SCRX is the bus-fed or solid-fed static exciter (scrx... parameters). ESDC1A (IEEE 421.5-2005 DC1A) is the dc commutator exciter with quadratic saturation (dc1a... parameters). EXDC2 (IEEE 1981 DC2, its regulator limits VRMAX and VRMIN scaled by the terminal voltage) and IEEEX1 (IEEE 1979 type 1, constant limits) are the dc commutator exciters of ESDC1A's data and take the dc1a... parameters. ESAC8B (IEEE 421.5-2005 AC8B) is the PID-regulated alternator exciter (ac8b... parameters). ESST3A (IEEE 421.5-2005 ST3A) is the compound-source static exciter with an inner field-voltage loop: it reads the terminal voltage and current and the field current, and takes the st3a... parameters.

acLeadS.description: AC exciter lead time constant TC (s); TB = TC = 0 bypasses the lead-lag. Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acRegulatorTimeS.description: AC exciter regulator time constant TA (s). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acRegulatorMinPu.description: Lower limit of the AC exciter regulator lag: VRMIN for EXAC1, VAMIN for ESAC1A (pu). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acRegulatorMaxPu.description: Upper limit of the AC exciter regulator lag: VRMAX for EXAC1, VAMAX for ESAC1A (pu). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acExciterTimeS.description: AC exciter time constant TE (s, above 0). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acDemagnetisingKd.description: AC exciter demagnetising factor KD (armature reaction). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acExciterConstant.description: AC exciter constant KE (field resistance line slope). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acSatE1.description: AC exciter saturation point E1 (pu exciter voltage VE). Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.

acSatSe1.description: AC exciter saturation factor SE(E1); SE1 = SE2 = 0 for none. Required for models EXAC1 and ESAC1A in a gridsim-dynamics/2 file.
